description: Reuters reports several hundred in the Nairobi femicide march, but separate Mombasa and Lodwar events have no reported crowd sizes in the captured text.

description: The 30 December anti-abduction event is documented in Nairobi, but no simultaneous headcount is reported. Amnesty Kenya’s at-least-50 affected-person figure aggregates teargas/arrest reports across cities and is not attendance.
required_followup: Seek Nairobi-specific event attendance reporting; do not combine persons affected or other cities.

description: The Standard page was visibly premium-limited to caption and introduction. The caption supports that doctors demonstrated outside Nairobi Hospital on 16 December but gives no crowd size; Citizen Digital is only an advance notice.
required_followup: Use another permitted contemporaneous source, if available, for attendance and demands; no retry of the limited page.
